verses.text: Ay jun winh schekab' Dios skuchan Elías aj Tisbe t'a yol yik Galaad. Ha winh ix halan t'a winhaj rey Acab icha tik: Ha hin tik schekab' hin Jehová ko Diosal ha honh israel honh tik, ha wal t'a yichanh Jehová swalkan t'ayach to manhxo ol yak'laj nhab' t'a jaye' ab'il tik, malaj jab'ok yal ak'wal ol emok, masanto ha hin ol wal jun'elxo, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Elías chi' icha tik:
--Elanh t'a tik, b'at k'ub'ejkanel ha b'a t'a sch'olanil sti' ha' Querit, haton ha' sk'ochkan t'a ha' Jordán t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u.
Ha jun ha ha' chi' ol uk'ej, ha hinxo ol wal t'a nok' joj yik ol b'at nok' yak'kan ha wa'el, xchi t'a winh.
Ix sk'anab'ajej winhaj Elías tas ix yal Jehová chi', ix b'at sk'ub'anel sb'a winh t'a sch'olanil sti' ha' Querit chi'.
Junjun k'inhib'alil yet' junjun yemk'uhalil syik'anb'at swa'el winh nok' joj chi' yet' schib'ej, haxo jun ha ha' chi' syuk' winh.
Palta ix k'och stiempo'al ix tup ha ha' chi' yujto maxtzak yak'laj nhab'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Elías chi':
--Elanh t'a tik, ixikkan t'a chonhab' Sarepta t'a yol yik Sidón, tzach kan ta' junok tiempo'al. Toxo ix wal t'a jun ix ix chamnakxo yetb'eyum to ha ix ol ak'an ha wa'el, xchi t'a winh.

Ix el winhaj Elías chi', ix b'atkan winh t'a Sarepta chi'. Ayik ix k'och winh t'a sti' chonhab', ix yilanb'at jun ix ix winh, chamnakxo yetb'eyum ix, wan smolan chab' te' b'olob' ix. Ix yawtankot ix winh, ix yalan winh icha tik: --Mamax el t'a ha k'o'ol, b'at ik' junok waso ha' wuk'ej, xchi winh.
Wanxo sb'at ix yik'kot ha', ix awajxi winh t'a ix: --Tzin tewipax t'ayach to tzik'kot jab'ok pan hin wa'a, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi ix: --Wal t'a yichanh Jehová ha Diosal swala', malaj jab'ok ixim pan b'ob'il wu'uj, haxonhej wal jun b'ech jab' warina ya'ab'ilkan wu'uj t'a yol jun xalu yet' jab' waceite ay t'a yol yet'tal. Anhej ol hin k'ochxok yet' chab' hin b'olob' tik, ol hin wach' b'o'an jab' warina chi' hin wa yet' tzun wune' tik, ol lajwok chi', ol ko tanhwan cham ko b'a yuj wejel, xchi ix.

Ix yalan winhaj Elías chi' t'a ix icha tik: --Manh hach xiwok. Ixik, b'at b'o ixim icha ix aj halan chi', palta to tza b'ab'laj b'o'ej junok wik t'a jab' harina chi', tzik'ankot t'ayin, slajwi chi' ol ha b'o'an ik ol ha wa yet' winh unin chi'.

Yujto toxo ix yal Jehová ko Diosal ha honh israel honh tik to manh ol lajwok jab' harina ayem t'a yol ha xalu chi' yet' jab' aceite ayem t'a yol yet'tal chi', masanto yik ol yak'anxikot nhab' Jehová, xchi winh t'a ix.
Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at ix sb'o icha ix aj yalan winh chi'. Jantaknhej tiempo ix yak' jun wejel chi', ix wa winh yet' ix yet' pax heb' ayek' yet' ix t'a spat chi'.
Maj lajwi'el-laj jab' yarina ix chi' yet' jab' yaceite chi', icha ix aj yalan winhaj Elías chi' yuj Jehová.
Ix ek' jun pekti', ix ilya'an jun yune' ix chi'. Te ow ix aj jun syahelal chi', ix chami.
Ix yalan ix t'a winhaj Elías chi' icha tik: --Ach schekab' Dios, ¿tas halan ik t'ayin? ¿Tom yuj snachajkot hin mul yet' scham tzun wune' tik, yuj chi' hach jawi? xchi ix.
--Ik'kot winh une' chi' t'ayin, xchi winhaj Elías chi' t'a ix. Ix scha'anek' winh unin chi' winh t'a ix, ix yik'ank'e winh t'a yol scuarto, ix yak'anek' jichan winh t'a sat sch'at.
Wal chi' ix yalan winh t'a Jehová icha tik: Mamin Jehová hin Diosal, ¿tas yuj tzak'kot kusk'olal t'a yib'anh ix ix tz'ak'an hin posado tik, tza cha'an cham winh yune' ix tik? xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi', oxel ix b'at lachan winh t'a yib'anh winh unin chi', ix yalan winh t'a Jehová: Mamin Jehová hin Diosal, tzin k'an t'ayach to tzak'xi sk'inal winh unin tik, xchi winh.
Ix yab'an Jehová tas ix yal winh chi', ix jax sk'o'ol winh unin chi'.
Elanhchamel ix yik'emta winh unin chi' winh b'aj aykan ix snun chi', ix yak'anxi winh t'a ix, ix yalan winh: --Ilnab'i, toxo ix jax sk'o'ol winh une' tik, xchi winh.
Ix yalan ix t'a winh: --Ha tikne'ik swak'och t'a hin k'o'ol to yel schekab' hach ton Jehová Dios, ha tas schek ala', tz'elnhejk'ochi, xchi ix.
